verdict.rationale: Publishing statutory fee amounts is a fair question for an IP office, so the axis applies. The pack never shows any fee amounts. It only says annuities must be paid to keep rights valid, that wrongly paid fees can be refunded, and that updating agent data is free, none of which gives the actual statutory amounts for a filing or renewal.

support.subject: As a founder, the exact statutory fees for my transaction are published on the service's own pages — amounts, not a contact form
